assumptions: All graphs and digraphs are finite and simple unless the statement explicitly says otherwise.

definitions.definition: An orientation of a finite complete simple graph.
A directed cycle of length 3 whose three arcs have pairwise distinct colors.
A directed path all of whose arcs have one common color; the color may differ between target paths.

domain.description: Finite tournaments with every directed edge assigned one of three colors.

quantifiers.domain: finite tournaments T and arc colorings c:A(T)→{1,2,3}
a rainbow directed 3-cycle C, or a vertex v with the stated reachability property

statement.text: In every finite tournament whose arcs are colored with three colors, must there be either a rainbow directed 3-cycle or a vertex v from which every other vertex is reachable by a monochromatic directed path?

title: Monochromatic reachability or rainbow directed triangles
